description.zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
description.en: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh and en. zh is the default value, which indicates Chinese. en indicates English.
The application ID, which can be omitted.
The programming language, such as Java or Go.
The name of the Microservices Engine (MSE) namespace.
The scenario, uniformly fill in default.
